sanskrit_verse:
दिनमासार्धषण्मासत्रिमासाब्दभृतस् तथा ।
कर्म कुर्यात् प्रतिज्ञातं लभते परिभाषितम् ॥
transliteration: dinamāsārdhaṣaṇmāsatrimāsābdabhṛtas tathā / karma kuryāt pratijñātaṃ labhate paribhāṣitam //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has committed to action within defined timeframes—daily, monthly, half-yearly, six-monthly, yearly—or by specific duty-cycles, shall execute that action as declared; completion is ensured through alignment with the declared capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from conscious commitment and capacity declaration
Causation aligns with sequential manifestation of declared intent
Capacity-based responsibility is calibrated to temporal and functional scope
Restoration occurs through fulfillment of declared dharma-cycle
Consciousness alignment is achieved via integrity of execution
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent declares a recurring duty-cycle AND possesses operational capacity THEN system assigns executable timeframe
IF declared karma remains incomplete beyond cycle THEN initiate restorative realignment protocol
IF capacity shifts during cycle THEN adjust karma parameters without punitive consequence
IF karma aligns with declared pramāṇa THEN validate completion status automatically
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that legal actors are bound by their own declarations of capacity and duty-cycle. The court must assess not fault or blame, but the alignment between declared capacity and actual performance. Responsibility is determined by the integrity of the declared framework, not external imposition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through conscious declaration. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that karma unfolds in sequence with declared capacity. Responsibility is proportional to the clarity and integrity of the initial declaration. No punitive consequence arises; misalignment triggers realignment toward completion, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Conscious Completion Process upon unmet duty-cycle
Assign Mentorship Protocol to restore capacity clarity
Realign Environmental Conditions to Support Karma Fulfillment
Verify Pramāṇa Integrity Through Witness-Based Re-declaration
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores reality to its non-punitive essence, where consciousness alone adjudicates, and completion transcends judgment.
